_comment: engine: "classic" = the original pipeline. "fast" = the compiled core: many times faster, ground close to but NOT identical with classic. The fast_engine values are in METRES whatever the project unit; the first seven carry the names of TerraScan's Ground routine settings. max_building_size: one starting point per square of this size - lower it (20 to 30) for hilly projects where buildings are already in their own class. steep_iteration_angle: the iteration angle used on steep ground (iteration_angle is used on flat ground). ground_band: points this close to the ground surface are ground too, at most one per 0.3 m square - this is what gives a dense ground without roughness; 0 = surface points only. follow_surface: let the ground continue over hill tops, banks and ridges the plain routine cannot climb. remove_spikes: take single points that stand out of the surface back out.
